definitions: Puts a large amount of something onto a vehicle or into a container.
Puts a program or data into a computer's memory.
Inserts a film into a camera or a magazine into a gun.
Gives someone a lot of something, especially work or information.
examples: He loads the truck with timber.
The computer loads the operating system quickly.
She loads the camera with a new roll of film.
The boss loads him with extra tasks.
